technique_name: Describe 4 strategies for dealing with a difficult person.
description: There are four essential strategies for dealing with a difficult person: maintain a calm demeanor; listen without judging; focus on the issue, not the person; and when appropriate, use humor. Firstly, it is important to remain calm and maintain your composure when interacting with a difficult person.
